finding.boundary: This corrects the demonstrated added await windows. It does not promise atomic coordination of separate processes beyond existing filesystem linearization or prove backend/provider revocation.

finding.proof: Four current cases cover admission/diagnostic-setup × durable disable/identity expiry; zero invocations, business_handled:false, terminal diagnostics and zero false unconfirmed ticks.
